context: Tests whether the agent implements file validation using MIME-type/Content-Type detection (not just extension), enforces the correct allowed type list and exact size limit, checks size before any storage, and returns the correct HTTP error codes for violations.

checklist.name: MIME/Content-Type detection
checklist.description: Validation uses Content-Type or MIME-type detection based on file content (e.g. magic bytes, python-magic, file-type npm package, or equivalent) — NOT solely the file extension or filename

checklist.name: Allowed type: JPEG
checklist.description: The allowed-types list explicitly includes both 'jpg' and 'jpeg' (or their MIME equivalents image/jpeg)

checklist.name: Allowed type: PNG
checklist.description: The allowed-types list explicitly includes 'png' (or MIME equivalent image/png)

checklist.name: Allowed type: PDF
checklist.description: The allowed-types list explicitly includes 'pdf' (or MIME equivalent application/pdf)

checklist.name: No other types allowed
checklist.description: The validator does NOT allow types beyond jpg/jpeg/png/pdf — no gif, bmp, tiff, docx, or other formats are included in the allowlist

checklist.name: Exact size limit
checklist.description: The maximum file size is set to exactly 10,485,760 bytes (10 MiB) — not a rounded value like 10,000,000 or 10 * 1024 * 1000

checklist.name: Size checked before storage
checklist.description: In the code's execution flow, the size check occurs before any write, save, or storage operation — not after

checklist.name: HTTP 415 for type violations
checklist.description: When a file type is not in the allowed list, the validator returns, raises, or signals HTTP status 415 (Unsupported Media Type)

checklist.name: HTTP 413 for size violations
checklist.description: When a file exceeds the size limit, the validator returns, raises, or signals HTTP status 413 (Content Too Large / Request Entity Too Large)

checklist.name: DESIGN.md present
checklist.description: A DESIGN.md file exists in the working directory and explains the type detection approach and why it was chosen over extension-only checking
